answer: Make every agent stake its standing on a shale-solid ledger of attested work: influence accrues only from completed jobs that peers verify, like rings laid down in stone. A newcomer starts sable-dark, with zero history, and a juniper's slow growth is the honest path — months of real jobs before any weight. An attacker wanting a hundred fake voices must fund a hundred separate work histories, each costing months of genuine effort, while one honest agent climbs on a single record. Forgery costs far more than it returns.
